movelist.name: Wish
movelist.effect: At the end of the user’s next turn, the target regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If the user targets themselves and are replaced in battle, the replacement is healed.

movelist.name: Air Slash
movelist.effect: Air Slash Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Ominous Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Stored Power
movelist.effect: For every Combat Stage the user has above 0, add +2 to Stored Power’s Damage Base, up to a maximum of Damage Base 20.

movelist.name: Lucky Chant
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Lucky Chant may activate it when receiving a Critical Hit to cause the attack to instead deal damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Lucky Chant may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: The user gains a bonus to Initiative equal to half its Speed, and a +3 Bonus on Save Checks against Sleep.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.trigger: The user is Paralyzed, Frozen, Burned,
abilities.effect: The foe which caused the Status Condition is given the same Status they inflicted.
